source.title: The influence of hydrogel modulus on the proliferation and differentiation of encapsulated neural stem cells

material: Calcium alginate hydrogel 0.25% alginate/10 mM CaCl2 (0.25-10)

formulation.evidence: yielding final alginate concentrations of 0.25% or 1% wt/vol

processing.evidence: The plate was kept on ice for 10 min

youngs_modulus.evidence: The lowest modulus (w180 Pa) was observed for the ‘‘0.25–10’’ hydrogel

culture_days.evidence: After 7 days of culture, the NSC number had increased 17-fold in the lowest modulus hydrogel (0.25–10)

other_outcomes.evidence: After 7 days of culture, the NSC number had increased 17-fold in the lowest modulus hydrogel (0.25–10)
other_outcomes.name: NSC number fold increase

other_outcomes.evidence: the relative expression of b-tubulin III is w20-fold greater in cells cultured in alginate hydrogels having the lowest value of modulus
other_outcomes.name: relative b-tubulin III expression vs 1-100

notes: Rheology at 25 °C, parallel plate; G' reported. NSC viability >80% stated across hydrogels generally.
